title: aider_shim's cold seam moves the home on Windows too: USERPROFILE names the cold home as well
intention: A proof of this component that moves the home in-process moves it on every box: Path.home() is the scratch on Windows too.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienyoga9i (Windows): test_driver.py's _COLD_SEAM_SRC sets only os.environ['HOME'] to make ModelInfoManager's cache cold, and Path.home() reads USERPROFILE on Windows, so the seam leaves Path.home() at C:\Users\akien. Run in a child with a stub requests module, the unfixed seam gives (HOME, USERPROFILE, Path.home()) = (cold, C:\Users\akien, C:\Users\akien). This box has no aider venv (~/.cairn/devices/aider_shim/0/venv absent), so the venv teeth were not run here. scratch_home_bypass reads [] here: an in-process set inside a seam string.
traces_to: Law 3; Law 8 (a proof that reads the live home measures the box, not the code).
how: D1: _COLD_SEAM_SRC sets os.environ['HOME'] = os.environ['USERPROFILE'] = the cold home. D2: new tooth test_the_cold_seam_moves_the_home_on_every_box: run the seam in a child with a stub requests module; HOME, USERPROFILE and Path.home() all name the cold home. The USERPROFILE leg reds on Linux too, so a hollow of D1 reds on every box.

clauses.claim: the cold seam leaves Path.home() at the cold home on Windows, where it stayed at the live home
